title: Implement Parameterized Queries for Banking Operations
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 banking operations use string concatenation for SQL queries, creating critical SQL injection vulnerabilities that must be eliminated in C# modernization
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized access to customer accounts, potential data theft, and regulatory compliance violations
suggested_approach: Replace direct SQL with Entity Framework LINQ queries or stored procedures with parameterized inputs in C# implementation
success_criteria: All database queries use parameterized inputs
Banking operations maintain functional parity with legacy system

provenance.evidence: WHERE AccountNo=" & txtAccountNo.Text & "" - direct concatenation vulnerability

title: Implement Transaction Management for Deposit Operations
problem_statement: Legacy deposit operation lacks transaction management, risking data inconsistency during failures
risk_if_unaddressed: Account balance corruption during system failures, potential financial losses
suggested_approach: Wrap deposit operations in database transactions with proper rollback mechanisms using Entity Framework transaction scope
success_criteria: Failed deposits do not corrupt account balances

title: Add Input Validation and Error Handling
problem_statement: Legacy banking operations lack input validation and error handling, allowing invalid data processing
risk_if_unaddressed: Invalid account access, negative deposits, system crashes from malformed input
suggested_approach: Implement C# data annotations, custom validators, and comprehensive exception handling with appropriate HTTP status codes
success_criteria: Negative or zero deposits are prevented
All exceptions return appropriate error responses
Input validation covers all banking operation parameters

provenance.evidence: No validation or error handling in VB6 button click handlers

title: Implement Banking Operations Audit Trail
problem_statement: No audit logging exists for banking operations, preventing compliance with financial regulations
risk_if_unaddressed: Regulatory compliance violations, inability to track unauthorized access or fraudulent transactions
suggested_approach: Implement structured logging with correlation IDs, capturing all banking operations with timestamps, user context, and operation results
success_criteria: All balance checks are logged with account and timestamp
All deposits are logged with amount, account, and result
Audit logs are tamper-evident and searchable

provenance.evidence: No logging statements in legacy banking operations
